description: This file defines the InstructionFileMetadataStrategy class which implements the MetadataStrategyInterface for storing and reading encryption metadata envelopes in Amazon S3 using the AWS SDK for PHP.

classes.name: InstructionFileMetadataStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class implementing MetadataStrategyInterface to handle storing and retrieving encryption metadata envelopes via instruction files on Amazon S3.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the strategy with an S3Client and optional suffix for instruction files.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Stores the MetadataEnvelope to S3 by creating an instruction file with suffix appended to the object key.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Retrieves an instruction file from S3 and constructs a MetadataEnvelope from its contents.
